key_insight: CMDO improves population-based optimization by storing and reusing context–behavior–outcome memories to steer future search, rather than simply replaying past solutions.
engineering_relevance: This memory-driven search strategy is relevant for solar-cell and device-model calibration problems because it can adaptively explore nonlinear, noisy parameter spaces with limited prior assumptions.
method: Encodes experience in working, episodic, and consolidated memory.
Retrieves past search recipes by similarity to the current search state.
Reconstructs search from the current population using exploratory, directed, and local behaviors with adaptive geometry.
evidence_signal: The method was benchmarked on BBOB/COCO and CEC2017 tests against DE, CMA-ES, SHADE, GWO, HHO, and ORCA, and also on seven-parameter photovoltaic model fitting; it achieved the lowest median error on CEC2017 F10.
watch_item: Performance is problem-dependent, so the added memory mechanism may not consistently outperform strong optimizers and may increase implementation complexity.
paper_title: CMDO: A Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization Algorithm for Adaptive Population-Based Search
